source_caption_text:
This is actually how me and bro operate 

“Secondhand” by Don Toliver featuring Rema is the perfect soundtrack for a drive with bro. The smooth production, hypnotic melodies, and effortless chemistry between Don and Rema make it the kind of song that instantly sets the mood. Their vocals blend together so naturally that the track feels like it was made for late-night drives.

POV: me and bro are going to the same place at the same time, listening to the same music, just to eat the same food. “Secondhand” playing in the background somehow makes the whole situation feel even more perfect. No matter where we’re headed, having the same song on repeat makes the drive feel like its own little moment.

The funny part is that we’re basically doing everything together without even needing to plan it. Same destination, same playlist, and the exact same food waiting at the end. “Secondhand” really becomes the soundtrack to two bros operating on the exact same wavelength.

#dontoliver #rap #meme
